pretreatments.description: Dilution of olive oil waste residues (OP + OMWW) with tap water (WP), a physical pretreatment consisting of adding water to the feed mixture to mitigate acidity and reduce polyphenol concentration.
Basic pretreatment (BP), a chemical treatment where 2N NaOH is added to adjust pH to 12, stirred at 70 rpm for 24h at 30°C, followed by neutralization with 2N HCl.

Salt pretreatment with FeSO4 (SP_FeII), FeCl3 (SP_FeIi), MnSO4 (SP_Mn), or CaCO3 (SP_Ca), involving the addition of solid salts to achieve 5g/L concentration, pH adjustment to pH 2 with HCl, and subsequent neutralization.
Ultrasonic pretreatment (USP), applying 1.8 kW of power for varying durations in an ultrasonic bath to break down large molecules into smaller pieces, tested at doses of 8000 kJ/L and 750 kJ/L.

Combined pretreatment CP_Ca, combining ultrasonic rays at the highest dose (8000 kJ/L) with CaCO3 pretreatment; combined pretreatment CP_FeII, combining ultrasonic rays at the highest dose with FeCl3 pretreatment.
